description: This file defines the PersistableCustomerOptionValue class, which extends CustomerOptionValueEntity and implements Serializable. It manages a list of descriptions related to customer option values.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerOptionValue
classes.description: Class representing a persistable customer option value with descriptions, extending CustomerOptionValueEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of CustomerOptionValueDescription objects associated with this option value.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of CustomerOptionValueDescription objects associated with this option value.
